why: FACT-0382: the honest full-chain comparison is (widened surface + scorer + final consumer) against the DEPLOYED control, never against a widened-only control. FACT-0432 defect 1 measured that nothing enforced this - assoc_report.verdict() returned promotable true on a report whose only defect was the control's identity. Every entry here is matched on RECOMPUTED digests, so a byte-identical copy at another path binds and a tampered copy does not.
how_to_add_an_entry: scripts/win_bet/control_binding.py register --experiment EXP-#### --fold {0,1} --control <rows.json> --graph <graph> --receipt <receipt.json> --provenance '<what this artifact is and where it came from>'. Every digest is recomputed there from the bytes; none is copied from a field.
why_this_list_is_empty: NO deployed fold control has been registered yet, and that is the correct fail-closed state rather than an oversight: no committed spec declares chain_arms, so no full-chain control artifact exists to bind. An empty list refuses every control, which is the answer that cannot be wrong. The first agent to run a full-chain arm registers the deployed control it actually scored, with its provenance, before its report can be read.
